summary.headline: full-stack-fastapi-template is a TypeScript full-stack application built with FastAPI, React, Tailwind CSS and Vite.
summary.description: The repository contains 229 files across 24 modules, written mainly in TypeScript and Python. Execution starts in backend/app/initial_data.py, backend/app/main.py and frontend/src/main.tsx. Data is persisted through PostgreSQL and SQL (SQLModel). It integrates with Migrations (Alembic) and HTTP client (axios).
summary.architecture: The codebase is organised into 1 application packages: react-email. The UI layer lives in frontend/src/components, frontend/src/hooks and hooks. Requests enter through backend/app/api and frontend/src/routes (23 detected routes). Business logic sits in backend/app/core. "backend/app/core" is the most depended-upon module (6 dependents), so changes there ripple widely.

keyFindings.title: Layered architecture
keyFindings.detail: API/service code is separated from the persistence layer, which keeps data access in one place.
